title: [Construction of references to laws not in force in Jammu and Kashmir.]
text:
33. [Construction of references to laws not in force in Jammu and Kashmir.]—Omitted by the Jammu

_and Kashmir Reorganization (Adaptation of Central Laws) Order, 2020, vide Notification No. S.O._
1123(E), dated (18-3-2020) and Vide _Union Territory of Ladakh Reorganisation (Adaptation of Central_
_Laws) Order, 2020, notification No. S.O. 3774(E), dated (23-10-2020).]_
